intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: question on the map at zero, three quick options, a 1.5-s beat, a warm reveal, three short see-it beats, a tease and a loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.text: Think the Nile is just Egypt's river? How many countries share the Nile basin?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: It's eleven. Eleven countries, from Lake Victoria to the Mediterranean.
About six thousand six hundred and fifty kilometres: the longest river in Africa.
Two rivers make it: the White Nile from the lakes, the Blue Nile from Ethiopia, meeting at Khartoum.
More than three hundred million people rely on its water.
Knew it? Hit like, and subscribe. A new map question lands every day.

title: How many countries share the NILE basin?
